lessons.title: 2. contextlib.contextmanager
lessons.description: Use `@contextmanager` to build `opened_list` that yields a list and clears it on exit.

tests.name: test_opened_list
tests.unittest_code:
def test_opened_list(self):
    with opened_list() as items:
        items.append(1)
        self.assertEqual(items, [1])
    self.assertEqual(items, [])

lessons.title: 3. Timing Context (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Record elapsed seconds on a `Timer` object while inside the `with` block.

tests.name: test_timer
tests.unittest_code:
def test_timer(self):
    with Timer() as t:
        _ = sum(range(1000))
    self.assertGreaterEqual(t.elapsed, 0.0)

lessons.title: 4. Suppress Specific Errors (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement `suppress(exc_type)` that swallows the given exception type.

tests.name: test_suppress
tests.unittest_code:
def test_suppress(self):
    with suppress(ValueError):
        int('x')
    with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
        with suppress(ValueError):
            raise TypeError('nope')

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — contextlib.suppress — swallows specified exceptions in a with block
